headline: Greece's Eurobank Reports 14% Rise in 9M Profit, Raises NII Target
summary: Eurobank reported a 14% increase in net profit for the first nine months of 2026. The lender raised its full-year net interest income growth guidance to 9%.
why: Eurobank Ergasias is one of Greece's four systemic financial institutions.

impacts.name: Eurobank Ergasias
impacts.why: Nine-month profit grew 14% and net interest income guidance was upgraded.
